messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem backlog grooming. We need a compact action tracker for recurring streaming issues (timeouts, partials, reconnect storms). This thread should list owners, tiny acceptance, and recurrence detection work. Keep replies minimal.

alex: Agreed. I'll own the recurrence detector prototype. Goal: a nightly job that flags routes with >3 partial incidents in 7d and spikes in retry amplification. Acceptance: detector runs nightly, writes alerts to #incidents-alerts, and produces a CSV.

sara: I'll take cache stability items. Plan: TTL tuning, shard hotness smoothing, and a small shard-balancer patch. Acceptance: synthetic replay shows <30% of partials attributed to cold-shard hits over 72h.

jordan: I'll implement graceful-resume server hooks so clients can resume without full reconnect after transient partials. Acceptance: resume flow reduces full reconnects by 40% in canary.

rafi: ops-bot note: scheduling the weekly recurring-incident review on Mondays 11:00 UTC. I'll attach detector outputs.

kelly: I'll own rollout coordination and the rollback playbook for any user-facing changes. Acceptance: rollback takes <15m and we have automated rollback steps in deploy runbook.

alex: detector details (prototype):
```text
- input: 7d aggregated trace logs (route, session_id, chunk_count, ack_offset, server_shard)
- rules: partial_ratio > 0.7 for a session, OR partial_chunk_rate > 0.3% per route, OR retry_amplification_ratio > 1.5
- output: alert with top 3 correlated causes (shard, model, client_sdk)
```
I'll PR the first version to monitoring next week.

maya: instrumentation asks: add session.session_type label (api_key / browser / mobile), add last_chunk_offset tag, and expose client_sdk_version label. Acceptance: metrics emitted and visible in dashboards.

sara: noted. Also adding a replay annotation for the 03:00 UTC autoscaler window where we see spike. Will test with a synthetic autoscale + long-tail sessions run to verify.

jordan: resume flow design: server accepts resume_token and last_acked_offset, validates token, rehydrates KV cache fast-path, then streams remaining chunks. Risk: token replay. Mitigation: short-lived tokens (30s) and single-use flag. Acceptance: successful resume in canary tests without regressing latencies.

alex: small client change for SDKs: add opt-in sticky routing header "x-session-sticky: true" to prefer same shard for short-lived sessions. Acceptance: sticky routing reduces cross-shard resends in synthetic test by 25%.

maya: owners + deadlines (short items):
- recurrence detector prototype -> alex -> Fri EOD (acceptance above)
- cache TTL + shard-balancer patch -> sara -> next Thu (acceptance above)
- graceful-resume server impl -> jordan -> two-week sprint end (acceptance above)
- canary + rollback steps -> kelly -> before deploy (acceptance above)
- telemetry labels emission -> alex/sara -> Wed midday (acceptance: labels present in 72h metrics)

rafi: ops-bot: recorded owners and set weekly reminder.

kelly: plan for rollout windows: start with internal-canary (30m), then canary ramp (2 nodes -> 10 nodes over 1h), then prod ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3h) with health gates on partial_chunk_rate and session_stability_score.

maya: decision log: prioritize recurrence detection + telemetry first, then cache fixes, then resume. Rationale: detection lets us prioritize hotspots and avoid blind rollouts.

alex: adding a tiny sample CLI for ops to run detector locally:
```bash
./detect-recurrence --start=7d --route=all --out=recurrence.csv
```
I'll attach to PR.

sara: replay results (preliminary): TTL sweep reduced cold-shard hits by 35% in staging replay. Will run production sampling and post numbers.

jordan: infra PR for resume token storage and single-use support: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/streaming/45

maya: risk log (short):
- detector false positives -> mitigation: human review step and threshold tuning.
- resume token abuse -> mitigation: short TTL + single-use + token signature.
- sticky routing could create hot shards -> mitigation: adaptive sticky that decays for high QPS clients.

kelly: after we merge canary changes, I'll update the incident tracker ticket with final ramp schedule. Please add one-line acceptance confirmation in the ticket when you finish.

alex: detector PR opened, will link when CI passes.

maya: thanks team. We'll reconvene at next Monday review. Keep updates to this thread only for owners so ops-bot can collect them automatically.
